pt.selectedTitle: A Caça ao Tesouro Secreta da Família Spitz #Shorts
pt.description: Neste episódio divertido, a família Spitz decide fazer uma caça ao tesouro na sala de estar. Quem será que vai encontrar a grande surpresa escondida pelo Papai Vlad?

titleOptions: The Spitz Family Secret Treasure Hunt #Shorts
Where is the hidden living room treasure? #Shorts
en.selectedTitle: The Spitz Family Secret Treasure Hunt #Shorts
en.description: In this fun episode, the Spitz family decides to have a treasure hunt in the living room. Who will find the big surprise hidden by Dad Vlad?

text.pt: Hoje tem uma caça ao tesouro misteriosa na casa mais divertida de todas!
text.en: Today there is a mysterious treasure hunt in the most fun house of all!

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic cinematic 9:16 vertical portrait of Raven, a cute Black Pomeranian German Spitz dog wearing round gold-rimmed glasses, a white pearl necklace, and a colorful floral print blouse, standing in a cozy living room holding a mysterious golden map.

text.pt: Eu encontrei um mapa antigo escondido bem debaixo do tapete da sala.
text.en: I found an old map hidden right under the living room rug.

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic cinematic 9:16 vertical portrait of Vlad, a cream light golden-white Pomeranian German Spitz dog wearing thin round gold-rimmed glasses, a blue-and-white vertical striped button-down shirt, and a dark navy blue bow tie with tiny dots, smiling mischievously in the living room.

text.pt: Quem seguir todas as pistas com atenção vai ganhar um prêmio muito especial.
text.en: Whoever follows all the clues very carefully will win a very special prize.

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic cinematic 9:16 vertical portrait of Theo, a cream light orange Pomeranian German Spitz dog wearing rainbow multicolored frame glasses and a blue button-down shirt, looking excitedly at the treasure map in the living room.

text.pt: A primeira pista diz que devemos procurar perto dos livros mais pesados.
text.en: The first clue says that we must look near the heaviest books.

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic cinematic 9:16 vertical portrait of Luna, a black Pomeranian German Spitz dog wearing round gold-rimmed glasses, a white pearl necklace, and a pink ruffled blouse, searching near the bookshelf in the living room.

text.pt: Olhem só o que eu achei escondido atrás daquela grande enciclopédia azul.
text.en: Look what I found hidden right behind that large blue encyclopedia.

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic cinematic 9:16 vertical portrait of Jonny, a cream light golden Pomeranian German Spitz dog with no glasses, wearing a white button-down shirt and a dark bow tie, holding a small golden box in the living room with an excited expression.

text.pt: O tesouro verdadeiro estava aqui o tempo todo esperando por nós.
text.en: The true treasure was right here the entire time waiting for us.

scenes.imagePrompt: Photorealistic cinematic 9:16 vertical portrait of Vlad, a cream light golden-white Pomeranian German Spitz dog wearing thin round gold-rimmed glasses, a blue-and-white vertical striped button-down shirt, and a dark navy blue bow tie with tiny dots, opening a box full of tasty dog biscuits in the living room.

text.pt: Biscoitos fresquinhos para comemorar o sucesso da nossa grande caça ao tesouro.
text.en: Freshly baked biscuits to celebrate the great success of our treasure hunt.

text.pt: A família Spitz sempre transforma qualquer dia comum em uma aventura inesquecível.
text.en: The Spitz family always turns any ordinary day into an unforgettable adventure.

en: We are the Funny Spitz Family!
